name: Monster My Neighbour
summary: A 3-8 player deduction card game where players hide the monster card and try to win as or capture the monster.
rules_text: Shuffle 5 monster cards as monster deck. Make general deck from other cards. Each round build a starting deck with 1 Hunter, 1 Hide, 1 Wanted plus 8/12/16/20/24/28 cards for 3-8 players, plus one random monster card. Shuffle and deal 4 cards to each player. Player holding Wanted starts by playing it; then clockwise each plays one card face-up, never refilling. Hunter cannot be played turn 1, monster only on last turn unless its ability allows earlier. Hunter and Dog try to force a player to discard monster for an instant win; Hide protects against Hunters while in hand. Friend makes you allied with monster for scoring, but if a Friend forces the discard it is betrayal. If monster is played, monster and friends get 2 VP; if monster is forced discarded by non-friend, discarder gets 2 VP and all non-monster non-friends get 1; if forced by friend, all non-monster non-friends get 1. Discards from Friend go to bottom of general deck, from Dog go facedown to that player's pile. After 5 rounds most VP wins.
rating_reason: Hidden roles bluffing, card exchange, perfect fit
